phase_1.title: Phase 1 · M14 Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 7.62×51mm NATO primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 415 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 415 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 559 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 4-groove bore and accelerates to 850 m/s (3430 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Short-Stroke Pulse & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, independent short-stroke piston delivers a clean impulse while isolating heat forward of the receiver.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 20-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the M14 staged for its 700–750 RPM cyclic · renowned semi-auto accuracy cadence.

zh.headline: 斯普林菲尔德 M14 自动步枪：1957 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 作为 M1 加兰德步枪的直系现代传人，M14 以可拆卸 20 发盒式弹匣取代 8 发漏夹，并首创厄尔·怀特自断式短行程导气活塞：活塞后移 1.5 毫米后即自动封堵导气孔，使动作干脆利落且无需手动调气。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：M14 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1957 年问世的 斯普林菲尔德 M14 自动步枪 由美国斯普林菲尔德兵工厂（Springfield Armory）主导研制，定位为经典的自动战斗步枪。M14 虽仅作美军全面制式主力步枪服役数载便交棒 M16，却凭借卓越中远距精度与充沛 7.62mm 威力在海豹突击队与陆军精确射手岗位持续服役至今。
作为 M1 加兰德步枪的直系现代传人，M14 以可拆卸 20 发盒式弹匣取代 8 发漏夹，并首创厄尔·怀特自断式短行程导气活塞：活塞后移 1.5 毫米后即自动封堵导气孔，使动作干脆利落且无需手动调气。 整件装备总长 1,126 mm（整木胡桃枪托 · 22 in 枪管）、空重 4.1 kg，成为同期自动步枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1957 年，美国斯普林菲尔德兵工厂（Springfield Armory）推出了划时代的斯普林菲尔德 M14 自动步枪。M14 虽仅作美军全面制式主力步枪服役数载便交棒 M16，却凭借卓越中远距精度与充沛 7.62mm 威力在海豹突击队与陆军精确射手岗位持续服役至今。 它的核心设计聚焦于怀特自断式导气活塞自动计量所需燃气脉冲，无需繁琐手动调气阀，奠定了其在自动步枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 斯普林菲尔德 M14 自动步枪 的机械灵魂在于其「怀特自断式短行程导气活塞 · 加兰德系双突笋滚轮回转枪机」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，独立短行程活塞瞬时脉冲撞击枪机框，将热负荷与振源隔离在机匣前方，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用发蓝锻钢与油润精选胡桃木/桦木托精加工而成。右侧滚轮闭锁突笋沿操作拉杆凸轮槽顺滑旋转开锁，摩擦力极低，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。斯普林菲尔德 M14 自动步枪 采用怀特自断式短行程导气活塞 · 加兰德系双突笋滚轮回转枪机。在每个击发周期中，独立短行程活塞瞬时脉冲撞击枪机框，将热负荷与振源隔离在机匣前方。借助发蓝锻钢与油润精选胡桃木/桦木托工艺与高强度配合，实现了右侧滚轮闭锁突笋沿操作拉杆凸轮槽顺滑旋转开锁，摩擦力极低。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 7.62×51mm NATO 弹药规格与 559 mm 镀铬精密枪管（4 条右旋膛线 · 305 mm / 1:12 缠距），最高工作膛压约 415 MPa，可赋予弹头 850 m/s 的出膛初速与 3,430 J 动能，有效作用距离达 500 米。
内膛技术特点方面，559 mm 枪管结合精密微调觇孔表尺，600 米内点目标精度口碑卓著。同时，保留顶部桥夹导槽，既可快速更换 20 发弹匣也可在机匣上方压弹补充，令其在 700–750 发/分（全自动）· 精确半自动见长 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 559 毫米身管与 7.62×51mm NATO 口径，斯普林菲尔德 M14 自动步枪 实现了每秒 850 米的初速与 500 米有效射程。559 mm 枪管结合精密微调觇孔表尺，600 米内点目标精度口碑卓著，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 20 发容量的20 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与 37 mm 膛轴设计，斯普林菲尔德 M14 自动步枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 10.8 N·s 水平。精密国家赛级旋钮觇孔照门使 M14 后来成功转型为 M21 与 Mk 14 EBR 精确射手步枪。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-41）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 20 发容量的20 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与出色的整体工效，精密国家赛级旋钮觇孔照门使 M14 后来成功转型为 M21 与 Mk 14 EBR 精确射手步枪。欢迎在 BAY-41 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 斯普林菲尔德 M14 自动步枪 的机械魅力。

en.headline: Springfield M14: The 1957 Mechanical Legend
en.deck: Direct successor to the M1 Garand, the M14 replaces the 8-round en-bloc clip with a detachable 20-round box magazine and introduces the White self-regulating expansion-cutoff gas piston that shuts off gas flow after initial impulse. Preserved in 1:1 interactive 3D CAD scale across all 20 functional assemblies in BAY-41.

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the M14
paragraphs: Introduced in 1957 by Springfield Armory in United States, the Springfield M14 emerged as a defining Battle Rifle. Though succeeded as the general-issue infantry rifle by the M16, the M14’s long-range precision kept it in front-line U.S. service for decades as a designated marksman and ceremonial platform.

Direct successor to the M1 Garand, the M14 replaces the 8-round en-bloc clip with a detachable 20-round box magazine and introduces the White self-regulating expansion-cutoff gas piston that shuts off gas flow after initial impulse. Measuring 1,126 mm (Walnut Stock · 22 in Barrel) at an unloaded weight of 4.1 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Assault & Battle Rifle class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1957, Springfield Armory of United States introduced the Springfield M14. Though succeeded as the general-issue infantry rifle by the M16, the M14’s long-range precision kept it in front-line U.S. service for decades as a designated marksman and ceremonial platform. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — White cut-off gas system automatically meters propellant impulse without manual regulators — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Springfield M14 sits its White Self-Regulating Cut-Off Short-Stroke Piston · Garand-Pattern Rotating Bolt. Throughout every firing cycle, independent short-stroke piston delivers a clean impulse while isolating heat forward of the receiver, containing 415 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in blued forged ordnance steel paired with oil-finished walnut, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Anti-friction roller on the right bolt lug glides smoothly inside the operating-rod cam track, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Springfield M14 relies on White Self-Regulating Cut-Off Short-Stroke Piston · Garand-Pattern Rotating Bolt. During each cycle, independent short-stroke piston delivers a clean impulse while isolating heat forward of the receiver. Machined from blued forged ordnance steel paired with oil-finished walnut, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Anti-friction roller on the right bolt lug glides smoothly inside the operating-rod cam track.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 7.62×51mm NATO with 559 mm Chrome-Lined Barrel (4-Groove RH · 1:12" / 305 mm Twist), the Springfield M14 develops 850 m/s muzzle velocity and 3,430 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 500 meters.

Internally, 559 mm barrel paired with national-match aperture sights excels at 500–600 m point-target shooting. Combined with its 700–750 RPM cyclic · renowned semi-auto accuracy tempo, Retains top stripper-clip guide alongside detachable 20-round box magazines, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 7.62×51mm NATO through its 559 millimeter bore, the Springfield M14 achieves 850 meters per second and 500 meters of effective reach. 559 mm barrel paired with national-match aperture sights excels at 500–600 m point-target shooting.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 20-round 20-round detachable magazine body with a 37 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 10.8 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Precision click-adjustable aperture iron sights enabled its long rebirth as the M21 and Mk 14 EBR.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-41), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
acts.audioScript: Act Four: Engineering Legacy. Pairing its 20-round 20-round detachable magazine body with disciplined recoil geometry, Precision click-adjustable aperture iron sights enabled its long rebirth as the M21 and Mk 14 EBR. Explore BAY-41 in live section cut and exploded disassembly to study every working link of the Springfield M14.
